title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Coinbase Commerce page requests seed phrases, raising security concerns
summary: A Coinbase subdomain linked to its Commerce tool reportedly directed users to a withdrawal page asking to enter their seed phrases, raising concerns among security observers.

title: OP_NET launches Bitcoin DeFi push without bridges or wrapped BTC
summary: OP_NET has launched a “SlowFi” DeFi stack that runs smart contracts directly in standard Bitcoin transactions with BTC as the only gas asset, avoiding bridges and wrapped BTC.

title: Hacked crypto tokens drop 61% on average and rarely recover, Immune report says
summary: Beyond immediate losses, attacks often lead to prolonged downtime, liquidity shocks and confidence erosion, as interconnected DeFi systems amplify the impact across markets.

title: Apex Group’s Tokeny taps Polygon to debut chain for compliant tokenized RWAs
summary: Apex Group’s Tokeny and Polygon Labs are launching T-REX Ledger, a Polygon-based blockchain that aims to centralize compliance for ERC-3643 security tokens.

title: Crypto.com cuts 12% of staff as it accelerates AI push
summary: Crypto.com CEO Kris Marszalek announced a 12% workforce reduction due to AI integrations, warning that companies “that do not make this pivot immediately will fail.”

title: Bitcoin tests old 2021 top as gold falls to six-week lows under $4.7K
summary: Bitcoin price correction reversed at $69,500, preserving a new higher BTC trading range as gold led a post-Fed macro asset sell-off.

title: The era of listings and on-ramps is ending, as intent protocols make access native
summary: Listings and on-ramps monetized access scarcity. Intent-based protocols make it native to networks, ending gatekeeper detours forever.

title: Bitcoin ETF inflow streak snaps with $164M outflows amid BTC dip
summary: US Bitcoin and altcoin ETFs saw notable outflows on Wednesday as BTC dipped below $71,000 and investor sentiment returned to extreme fear.

title: Ethereum long squeeze risk rises as ETH price dips to $2,100
summary: Ether risks over $2.5 billion in long liquidations below $2K, with volatility increasing the chance of a retest of $1,800 support.
